message.content:
The value of a U.S. dollar against the British pound fluctuates daily. As of the most recent market data, $20 is roughly equivalent to **£15–£16**.  

> **Note:** Exchange rates change constantly, so the exact amount you receive may differ slightly depending on the time of the transaction and any fees applied by your bank or currency‑exchange service. If you need a precise, up‑to‑date conversion, you can check a reliable financial news site, a currency‑converter app, or your bank’s website.
